limitations: No independently verified NFL transaction/injury or depth-chart feed is included.
No projection, breakout probability, or fantasy start recommendation is computed.
Weekly defensive snaps may be missing even for confirmed participants; null never means zero.
Snap share is null without a verified team defensive snap denominator.
Tackles = observed solo plus assisted counts; original scoring conventions may differ from paid source statistics.
A three-week raw snap change is a descriptive signal, not a snap-share trend or validated breakout.
Games with no confirmed participant evidence are omitted, not set to zero; bye/injury gaps invalidate consecutive-week trend.
Historical source values can be revised; use source_sha256 hashes to detect changes.
source: Sleeper public /v1/stats/nfl/regular/2026/{week} exact IDs and existing LOG public player-index metadata
